errors.description: The model hallucinates that every cube has 3 hidden yellow faces, which contradicts the ground truth where only 2 yellow faces are hidden in total across all cubes. This is a complete fabrication of color assignments.

The ground truth specifies a fixed camera angle (phi=70°, theta=-45°) and defines exactly which three faces per cube are hidden — not all faces that are ever out of view during rotation.

errors.evidence_quote: Total hidden yellow faces = 5 cubes × 3 hidden yellow faces per cube = 15.
errors.description: The model multiplies 5 cubes by 3 (fabricated) yellow hidden faces per cube to get 15. The correct count is 2, as per ground truth. The math is internally consistent but based entirely on false premises.

analysis_result.analysis: The model commits multiple major errors: it hallucinates yellow faces on every cube’s hidden surfaces, misidentifies face colors (e.g., assigning yellow to bottom face of Cube 1 when it’s purple), and invents a rule that all non-visible faces during rotation count as hidden — contrary to the fixed camera angle specified in the ground truth. The final answer of 15 is entirely fabricated and contradicts the correct count of 2 hidden yellow faces.
